workspaceName.description: Prefix for generated <workspaceName>[.<Name>].local.code-workspace files and the display name of this hub folder. Defaults to the hub folder name.

extensions.description: VS Code extension IDs recommended in the generated workspace.

reposDir.description: Folder (relative to hub repo root) where repos are cloned. Must be gitignored.

worktreesDir.description: Folder (relative to hub repo root) for git worktrees. Must be gitignored.

name.description: Folder name and workspace folder name. Unique.

tags.description: Used with -Tag to build focused workspaces (e.g. ui, api, dotnet).

docs.description: Path (relative to the hub repo) to this repo's overview doc, read by AI agents.

optional.description: If true, only cloned when selected explicitly via -Only or -Tag.
